ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in linear streaks and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke regions are solid low-intensity black; high-contrast white contiguous blobs are localized at the extreme lateral tips (lobes); high-intensity linear pixel strings crisscross the central dark mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an acute internal angle; depth of the notch is approximately 5% of the total vertical height of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct jagged peaks visible against the lighter sky/water background, particularly on the inner curves of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the median notch toward the lateral tips, followed by a sharp downward taper at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white circular pixel clusters concentrated at the distal left and right lobe tips; smaller isolated white circular spots along the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, overlapping white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering approximately 40% of the visible ventral surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive overlapping linear rake marks across the entirety of both lobes; irregular margin at the distal tips suggesting historical tissue loss or erosion.
